fields.label: KYC Type
fields.description: Master list managed under KYC Check Type — used both for grouping vendors and for the Block Supplier On Hold rules in KYC Settings

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Only Enabled vendors show up in the Supplier KYC Validation dialog

fields.label: Default Selected
fields.description: Pre-checked by default in the Supplier dialog (KYC Settings default list also applies)

fields.label: Credential
fields.description: Row from KYC Settings > Credentials table

fields.label: Request Style
fields.options:
JSON Body
Form Data
Query Params

fields.label: Endpoint Path
fields.description: Appended to Credential's Base URL, e.g. /api/v1/corporate/gstin

fields.label: Request Body Template
fields.description: Use {{placeholder_key}} tokens defined in Field Map below, e.g. {"id_number": "{{id_number}}"}

fields.label: Success Path (dotted JSON path)
fields.description: Dotted path checked in the response, e.g. data or data.pan_status

fields.label: Expected Value at Success Path (optional)
fields.description: Leave blank to just check the Success Path is non-empty/truthy. Set this to require an exact match, e.g. VALID for data.pan_status — case-insensitive.

fields.label: Success Message Path (optional)
fields.description: Dotted path to a human-readable message shown on success, e.g. data.pan_status_desc

fields.label: Error Type Path
fields.description: Dotted path to an error/type code in the response, if the provider returns one

fields.label: Error Message Path
fields.description: Dotted path to a human-readable error message, e.g. error.message or message

fields.label: System/Infra Error Keywords (one per line)
fields.default:
credit limit
rate limit
quota
unauthorized
invalid api key
internal server error
service unavailable
timeout
authentication
fields.description: If the Error Type or Error Message contains any of these (case-insensitive), the result is classified as 'Error' (system/account problem) instead of 'Failed' (the entered data itself is invalid). This distinction matters because 'Error' should NOT count against Block-Supplier-on-Failure rules or be shown to the user as 'wrong data'.
